source: MAME mslugx euro. Run 1: 36 snapshots of the existing region (MAME 0.276, tools/capture_mission.lua). Run 2: 86 snapshots, frames 2100..7200, tools/capture_advance.lua rerun on MAME 0.264; its positions.csv is identical in the camera and loader traces.

validation.tolerance: exact SCB reconstruction except recorded variant coordinates; uncovered MAME RGB8 pixels <=1 per channel

map.note: The earlier 0.276 advance capture reported 4953328 uncovered pixels; this 0.264 rerun covers 4952880. Map pixels and variants match.

known.height: 1 player-following transient (frame 3900) and 44 frames after the unrecovered 16 px lift at camera 1920

camera_traces.jumping: tools/capture_camera.lua MSX_CAMERA_LAST=7200: height rises 0->16 between camera 947 and 1008, exactly ceil((camera-944)/4); middle bank full speed at camera 1023 (frame 3404); transient rise to 23 at camera 1550..1607 while the player jumps; another 16 px at camera 1920 from frame 4566.
camera_traces.no_jump: MSX_CAMERA_JUMP=0: rise starts at camera 947 but stops at 14 (camera 1008..1470); middle bank switch also at camera 1023.

collision.layer_switch: tools/trace_collision_loader.lua (frames 2100..4400): query PC 0xC7A1A reads the foreground grid 17178 times before the switch and the middle grid 20061 times after; at the switch PC 0xC75A0 reads 2048 foreground words and 0xC75A2 writes 4096 middle bytes; the loader (0xC734E..0xC735A) writes the foreground ring only up to camera 1022.
